title: Morgan Stanley says quantum computing could be a $100 billion market one day. Here’s its top stock to play the trend
key_facts: Morgan Stanley raised Quantinuum Inc. (QNT) from equal-weight to overweight
Price target $62, about 88% above Wednesday's close
Analyst Joseph Moore wrote the note, released Thursday 15 Oct 2026
Sector could reach over $100 billion in annual revenue by 2040, from about $10 billion in 2030
2027 seen as hardware turning point, with Quantinuum's upcoming Sol system a landmark
Quantinuum sales seen rising from about $270 million in 2028 to $2 billion by 2030
QNT shares down about 40% this year; retail sentiment on Stocktwits bearish
quote_evidence: Morgan Stanley projects that commercial adoption of early quantum computers could expand the total addressable market from approximately $10 billion in 2030 to over $100 billion by 2040.
In a note released Thursday, analyst Joseph Moore upgraded the company's rating from equal-weight to overweight with a price target of $62 per share.
why_it_matters_hint: A major bank backing a quantum pure-play and a long-term market forecast.
notes: CNBC original blocked (403, returned only an error page); read the Stocktwits piece carried by Yahoo Finance. Analyst forecast, not advice. Moore described as Morgan Stanley analyst per the article; his specialism not stated.
